say:2:1430208201:1.text: The difference is huge! If Drexel inherits his uncle's title, he'll be able to move into that big mansion.
say:2:1430208201:1.source_cn: 区别很大，如果德雷瑟能继承叔叔的爵位，那么他将搬到贵族...
say:2:1430208201:1.male: The difference is huge! If Drexel inherits his uncle's title, he'll be able to move into that big mansion.
say:2:1430208201:1.female: The difference is huge! If Drexel inherits his uncle's title, he'll be able to move into that big mansion.

say:3:1430208202:1.text: Also, the Divine Dew will be plentiful! I heard that the Divine Dew for nobles is completely different from the ones the commoners get!
say:3:1430208202:1.source_cn: 还有恩典灵露！据说供给贵族的灵露可和普通人的不一样！
say:3:1430208202:1.male: Also, the Divine Dew will be plentiful! I heard that the Divine Dew for nobles is completely different from the ones the commoners get!
say:3:1430208202:1.female: Also, the Divine Dew will be plentiful! I heard that the Divine Dew for nobles is completely different from the ones the commoners get!

say:4:1430208203:1.text: When I become a noble, I need to find out if what I heard is true.
say:4:1430208203:1.source_cn: 等我成为贵族，我一定要亲自品鉴一番，看看两者到底有什么区别。
say:4:1430208203:1.male: When I become a noble, I need to find out if what I heard is true.
say:4:1430208203:1.female: When I become a noble, I need to find out if what I heard is true.
